job.name: ig28_host
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary woman (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
job.meaning: преподаватель английского ~38: тёмно-русое каре до плеч, бордовая блуза, светлый домашний кабинет с книжными полками
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a friendly, confident Russian woman English teacher about 38 with dark-blonde shoulder-length bob, small silver earrings, light natural makeup, a burgundy silk blouse, sitting at a light wooden desk with an open notebook. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium shot from the waist up, both shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 16% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, NO smile. Background: a bright cosy home study with white bookshelves, a small globe and a plant, soft daylight from a window, blurred. Look: a real frame from a high-end camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark.
